textes.hub_desc: Riads, villas, apartments and guesthouses in Marrakech, Agadir, Djerba, Nice, Lisbon… Rentals between individuals, with no service fees.

marrakech: Riads in the medina, villas with pools in the Palmeraie, modern apartments in Gueliz: find your vacation rental in Marrakech, with no service fees.

The Red City is one of Morocco's most popular destinations. People come for the buzz of Jemaa el-Fna square and the souks, the calm of the gardens, days by the pool and trips to the Atlas Mountains, an hour's drive away. A typical stay is split between a riad in the heart of the medina, for the atmosphere, and a quiet villa outside the city, to relax.
the historic heart, its riads and souks, everything within walking distance
the new town: modern apartments, restaurants, shops
villas with gardens and pools, peaceful, a few minutes from the centre
guesthouses and villas in the countryside, with views of the Atlas

Spring (March to May) and autumn (September to November) have the most pleasant temperatures. Summer is very hot, so a pool is a real plus. Winter is mild during the day but cool in the evening: look for heating.
The souks and Jemaa el-Fna square
A hot-air balloon flight at sunrise
A day in the Ourika Valley or the Agafay desert
agadir: Ocean-view apartments, villas and holiday homes in Agadir: book directly with the host, with no service fees.

With its long sandy beach and sunshine almost all year round, Agadir is the great seaside resort of southern Morocco. It is ideal for families and sunny winter breaks, with a lively seafront promenade, a marina and many excursions to Paradise Valley or Souss-Massa National Park.
ocean-view apartments, a stone's throw from the beach
recent residences with pools, in a quiet setting
practical and well connected, close to Souk El Had
Agadir can be visited all year round thanks to its mild climate. Winter attracts those escaping the European cold; summer stays cooler than inland thanks to the ocean.
taghazout: Surf hostels, sea-view apartments and village houses in Taghazout and Tamraght: the surf coast, with no service fees.

North of Agadir, the villages of Taghazout and Tamraght have become a haven for surfers and ocean lovers. The vibe is relaxed: surf lessons, rooftop yoga, sunsets over the Atlantic and fresh food. You will find friendly hostels as well as comfortable apartments with sea views.
closest to the surf spots and cafés
recent residences with pools and beach access
The best waves arrive from October to April. Summer suits beginners and families, with a calmer ocean.
The Anchor Point and Banana Beach surf spots
essaouira: Riads in the medina, country houses and sea-view apartments in Essaouira: book with no service fees.

A fortified port town listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Essaouira charms visitors with its white and blue medina, its craftspeople, its fishing port and the wind that kitesurfers love. The atmosphere is artistic and peaceful, about three hours' drive from Marrakech.
riads and traditional houses inside the ramparts
The climate stays mild all year round. Summer is cooler than in Marrakech, with a steady wind that board-sports fans love.
The ramparts and the harbour Skala
The fishing port and its grilled fish
tanger: Apartments overlooking the Strait, houses in the Kasbah and villas in Tangier: your vacation rental with no service fees.

Where the Mediterranean meets the Atlantic, facing Spain, Tangier has a unique cosmopolitan history. Its Kasbah, medina, legendary cafés and beaches make it as much a cultural destination as a seaside one, and it is easy to reach from Europe.
traditional houses with terraces over the Strait
Spring and summer are the ideal seasons; winter is mild but rainier.
Cape Spartel and the Caves of Hercules
A trip to Asilah or Chefchaouen
fes: Riads and guesthouses in the medina of Fez: immerse yourself in the imperial city, with no service fees.

Fes el-Bali, its UNESCO-listed medieval medina, is one of the largest car-free urban areas in the world. Tanneries, madrasas, leather and copper craftsmen: staying in a riad in Fez means living to the rhythm of the oldest of Morocco's imperial cities.
the historic medina and its restored riads
the district of the royal palace and the mellah
modern apartments, convenient for getting around
Spring and autumn are perfect for exploring the medina on foot. Summer is hot, winter cool.
A trip to Meknes and Volubilis
casablanca: Apartments, studios and villas in Casablanca for a business trip or a family stay, with no service fees.

Morocco's economic capital, Casablanca combines Art Deco architecture, business districts and a long seafront on the Atlantic. It is an ideal stop for a business trip, a family visit or the start of a tour of Morocco.
Art Deco buildings, close to the train stations
Mild ocean climate all year round, ideal in any season.
The Art Deco architecture of the centre
rabat: Vacation rentals in Rabat: apartments, houses in the Kasbah of the Udayas and villas, with no service fees.

The capital of Morocco, Rabat is a green and peaceful city listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Kasbah of the Udayas, the Hassan Tower, the beach and the seafront make it a pleasant and easy-going destination.
central apartments, close to public transport
Pleasant all year round thanks to the ocean.
The Hassan Tower and the Mausoleum of Mohammed V
Salé and its medina, across the river
djerba: Traditional houchs, villas with pools and apartments in Djerba: your sunny holiday, with no service fees.

An island in southern Tunisia known for its fine sandy beaches, white houses and relaxed way of life, Djerba is ideal for a sunny holiday with family or friends. Houchs, the traditional Djerbian houses, offer an authentic experience.
the main town, its souk and its port
villas and residences close to the beaches
May to October for the beach; winter stays mild and sunny, perfect for long stays.
Djerbahood, the street-art village of Erriadh
hammamet: Villas, apartments and holiday homes in Hammamet and Yasmine Hammamet, with no service fees.
Tunisia's iconic seaside resort, Hammamet offers long beaches, a waterfront medina and a lively marina in Yasmine Hammamet. An easy, sunny destination, an hour's drive from Tunis.
houses and apartments close to the sea
villas with gardens, in a quiet setting
May to October for swimming; spring is ideal for exploring the region.
A trip to Nabeul and Cap Bon
sousse: Apartments, villas and holiday homes in Sousse and Port El Kantaoui, with no service fees.
The "Pearl of the Sahel" combines a UNESCO-listed medina, lively beaches and the marina of Port El Kantaoui. A vibrant destination, ideal for mixing culture and relaxation.
at the heart of history, near the ribat
marina, golf and residences with pools
May to October for the beach; winter is mild.
The amphitheatre of El Jem, nearby
tunis: Apartments in Tunis, houses in Sidi Bou Said, La Marsa and Carthage: your vacation rental with no service fees.
Between the medina of Tunis, the ruins of Carthage and the white-and-blue village of Sidi Bou Said, the Tunis area offers a stay rich in history, with the beaches of La Marsa and Gammarth nearby.
white and blue houses overlooking the gulf
villas and apartments close to the beaches
to discover the city on foot
Spring and autumn for sightseeing, summer to enjoy the northern beaches.
The village of Sidi Bou Said
nice: Sea-view apartments, studios in Old Nice and villas on the French Riviera: book with no service fees.

Nice, with its Promenade des Anglais, colourful Old Town and light, made the French Riviera famous. An ideal starting point for Monaco, Villefranche-sur-Mer or the hinterland, the city can be enjoyed all year round.
narrow streets, markets and characterful apartments
sea views and a village feel
The Carré d'Or and the Promenade
apartments a stone's throw from the beaches
May to October for the sea; the mild, sunny winter also attracts many visitors.
paris: Apartments and studios in Paris, from the Marais to Montmartre: your short-term rental with no service fees.

Museums, characterful neighbourhoods, bistros and the banks of the Seine: Paris is best discovered on foot and by metro. An apartment lets you live the city like a Parisian, as a family or a couple, for a weekend or a long stay.
central, lively, ideal for a first visit
village atmosphere and views over Paris
Every season has its charm: spring and autumn are the most pleasant for strolling.
lisbonne: Apartments in Alfama, Chiado or Bairro Alto in Lisbon: your vacation rental with no service fees.
The city of seven hills, Lisbon charms with its yellow trams, miradouros, azulejos and its light over the Tagus. The beaches of Cascais and the magic of Sintra are less than an hour away.
the historic district, its alleys and fado
central, lively, ideal for going out
quieter, near the monuments and the river
March to October for good weather; winter is mild.
barcelone: Apartments in Barcelona, from the Eixample to Barceloneta: your vacation rental with no service fees.
Gaudí, the sea, tapas and lively nightlife: Barcelona combines city and beach like few other capitals. A rental apartment is the most practical way to enjoy it with family or friends.
elegant and central, near the Sagrada Família
The Gothic Quarter and El Born
right by the water, close to the beaches
May to October for the beach; spring and autumn for relaxed sightseeing.
The Sagrada Família and Park Güell
La Rambla and the Boqueria market
geneve: Apartments and houses in Geneva and around Lake Geneva: your short-term rental, prices in Swiss francs, with no service fees.

An international city on the shores of Lake Geneva, Geneva offers a remarkable quality of life: the Jet d'Eau, the old town, lakeside parks and mountains nearby. An ideal base for exploring the Vaud Riviera, Annecy or Chamonix.
a Sardinian-style village feel, cafés and craftspeople
Summer for the lake, winter for the nearby ski resorts.
The Jet d'Eau and the lakeshore
CERN and the Palais des Nations
A trip to Annecy or Montreux
